import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill NaN in 'Sleep Disorder' with 'None' to create a distinct category
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)

# Clean up the 'Sleep Disorder' column to merge 'Sleep Apnea' and 'Apnea'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].replace({'Sleep Apnea': 'Apnea'})

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' numerical columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True)
df['Systolic'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Systolic'])
df['Diastolic'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Diastolic'])

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the aesthetic style and context for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")
sns.set_context("talk", font_scale=0.8)

# Create a figure with a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 14))
fig.suptitle('Key Health Metrics by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Quality of Sleep',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Stress Level',
    sizes=(30, 200),
    alpha=0.7,
    palette='viridis'
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Duration (Size by Stress)', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sleep Disorder')

# Plot 2: Distribution of Physical Activity by Sleep Disorder
sns.violinplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Physical Activity Level',
    palette='plasma',
    inner='quartile'
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity Distribution', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# Plot 3: Heart Rate vs. Systolic Blood Pressure
sns.kdeplot(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Systolic',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    fill=True,
    alpha=0.6,
    palette='magma'
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate vs. Systolic BP Density', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)

# Plot 4: BMI Category Counts by Sleep Disorder
bmi_counts = df.groupby(['Sleep Disorder', 'BMI Category']).size().reset_index(name='Count')
sns.barplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=bmi_counts,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Count',
    hue='BMI Category',
    palette='cividis'
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('BMI Category Breakdown', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Individuals', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='BMI Category')

# Adjust layout to prevent overlap
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.close(fig)
